# A Message from Plug CEO on the Stream Data Centers Announcement


July 13, 2026


Following today’s announcement, Plug CEO Jose Luis Crespo shares additional perspective on the Company’s transactions with Stream Data Centers, discussing the strategic importance of advancing Plug’s infrastructure optimization initiatives, strengthening the Company’s financial position, and unlocking new opportunities across the data center market.
